# Phase 7 — Final Revelation Plan: Thirty Additional Refinements

> The final plan is not a frozen stone; the Awtsmoos renews it as evidence grows;
> each verified boundary becomes a stronger vessel, and the living movie flows.

1. Use milliseconds at the canonical boundary.
2. Normalize width/height/fps in project settings.
3. Require total duration > 0.
4. Require scenes to remain within project duration.
5. Give every scene a dimensional mode: `2d`, `3d`, or `hybrid`.
6. Give every entity a semantic kind.
7. Include people/characters separately from generic shapes.
8. Include text blocks with semantic roles.
9. Include chart entities with data payloads.
10. Include arrow/callout entities for tutorials.
11. Include particle entities with deterministic seeds.
12. Include camera shots with size/angle/motion intent.
13. Include transitions between scenes.
14. Include keyframes as generic property animation records.
15. Keep audio/narration metadata optional.
16. Let AI intent specify audience and teaching goal.
17. Let AI intent specify desired duration and scene cadence.
18. Expand sparse intent into multiple scene archetypes.
19. Guarantee a cinematic opening and composite finale in showcase mode.
20. Alternate 2D, 3D, hybrid, tutorial, and infographic scenes.
21. Preserve adapter source references for debugging.
22. Return unsupported kinds instead of dropping them invisibly.
23. Provide target-app recommendation by capabilities.
24. Test all four projections from one canonical project.
25. Test that 180000ms is preserved exactly.
26. Test at least ten scenes.
27. Test multiple camera angles and camera motions.
28. Test multiple character entities.
29. Test many shape/text/effect entities and keyframes.
30. Test mobile browser surfaces only after real integration is present.
31. Re-read every generated source file after writing.
32. Run line-count checks on all touched code.
33. Run tab-indentation/style checks where meaningful.
34. Run Node syntax/import tests before render.
35. Render using the repository's existing Animator path rather than a fake isolated canvas.
36. Inspect render duration/frames/output metadata.
37. Re-run adapters after render changes.
38. Record console/runtime failures verbatim in verification notes.
39. Resolve every discovered delta before closure.
40. Keep app identities visually and architecturally distinct.
